purpose: Test whether deterministic admission of at most two heavy incomplete-parent terminal players per active window removes V170 terminal starvation while retaining its multiway-overload protection and passed throughput gate.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

causal_diagnosis.interpretation: V170's all-or-none active branch rejects every heavy terminal player, so rejected collectable work remains visible and can keep the guard active for most of the run. A quota of two is the unique continuous extension of the frozen rule: zero, one, or two heavy players are already all admitted when inactive; when three or more exist, admit the first two deterministically and reject only excess concurrency.

single_mechanism_change_from_v170.activation_rule: unchanged: active exactly when current heavy incomplete-parent terminal player count is strictly greater than two
single_mechanism_change_from_v170.inactive_rule: unchanged exact V159 terminal admission for zero, one, or two heavy players
single_mechanism_change_from_v170.active_rule: admit at most two heavy incomplete-parent terminal players selected by ascending request_id then function_id; reject every remaining heavy terminal player; all light terminal and parents-completed behavior remains V170
unchanged: SRPT request order and critical-path rank definition
V159 nonterminal short-work admission at remaining work at most 5.5 and queue density strictly below 8
Hiku2/OCS queue-density-8 placement router and all player scores
NSESche solver, welfare, pricing and feasibility
common HPA, tapes, metrics and policy-independent references

at most two heavy terminal players are admitted in every active window and all excess heavy players are rejected
